safeInterpretation: TARGET_NULL is an ordered first-failure count, not recovered-candidate count if the target gate were removed.
LOW_RR is distinct from TARGET_NULL; target-null must never be coerced to RR=0.
FINAL_GRADE_REJECTED is downstream of RR pass and must not be pooled with LOW_RR.
Source-specific target conclusions require same-scan feature/history capture or a future immutable decision-state receipt.
A row can be formally target-null under observed inputs while the economic explanation remains UNKNOWN because targetPrice source/coverage is unproven.
